title: Rule 08 — Directions as ready-made chunks
short: Memorize destinations with their preposition, rather than learning every case rule now.
syntax:
nach Berlin / nach Hause
zum Bahnhof / zur Apotheke
mit dem Bus / mit der Bahn
body: Many prepositions select a specific case. For a small speaking system, memorizing whole phrases is easier and remains grammatical.
examples: I am going to the station.
pitfall: It is “nach Hause” (homeward) but “zu Hause” (at home). Learn them as separate expressions.
